summary.text: Dale Patten is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 26 (Watford City) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dale Patten's service as "Senate since 2019". The member page lists Dale Patten's committee assignments as including Energy and Natural Resources (Chairman) and the Finance and Taxation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dale Patten's occupation as Retired Banker.
It lists education as BS, Animal Science, NDSU.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: McKenzie County Commission (2000-2012).
Dale Patten is listed as married to Joy with 2 children.
